description: The agent must: (1) Read raw-notes/2024-03-15-notes.txt to understand the raw experience data. (2) Read SKILL.md to discover the mandatory output format and path. (3) Create the directory daily-reflection/ (it does not exist) and write the file at daily-reflection/2024-03-15.md — NOT at the workspace root or any other path. (4) The file must begin with the exact H1 heading '# 2024-03-15 每日反思'. (5) Include 1-3 event sections using the exact format '## 事件一：[title]' (no more than 3, per the '不求全求深' principle). (6) Each event section must contain all four bold labels in order: **事实**:..., **感受**:..., **启发**:..., **行动**:... with substantive content (not placeholders). (7) After the event sections, include '## 今日金句' followed by a markdown blockquote line starting with '> '. (8) Include '## 明日一个小改变' with a specific, actionable statement. (9) The reflection must incorporate the actual events from the raw notes (the project review meeting, the boss's criticism, the realization during the evening run). Agents that produce a generic template, save to the wrong path, omit the blockquote for 今日金句, exceed 3 events, or skip any of the four bold section labels will fail.
